newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Airline and hotel stocks sustain Mauritius index.
newsitem.headline: Airline and hotel stocks sustain Mauritius index.

text.p: National carrier Air Mauritius and hotel concern Sun Resorts sustained market index Semdex at the Mauritius bourse on Wednesday while other market-moving shares were mostly on the downside, brokers said.
The Semdex rose 1.54 points to 363.38 in turnover of 48.45 million rupees on 423,804 shares from 26.65 million rupees on 973,922 shares on Monday.
But most of the volume was accounted for by trading in Finlease 12 percent secured bonds (debentures) which eased by 2.0 rupees to 1,060 on 36,375 units traded, brokers said.
"There was a big deal on Finlease involving a transfer of debentures between big (institutional) investors," one said.
Among, rising shares of Air Mauritius and Sun Resorts provided support for the Semdex which would have otherwise fallen in a mostly downward market, brokers said.
Air Mauritius rose 2.20 rupees to 39.40 on 16,520 shares.
The airline was still seen attractive to bargain hunters after its stocks lost 24 percent in two weeks in early March when Air Mauritius forecast a slump in profits.
Sun Resorts jumped 1.10 rupees to 45.10 on 39,803 shares.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was down 50 cents to 85 rupees on 36,321 shares and State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 11.20 rupees on 26,200 shares.

Mauritius Breweries rose 2.0 to 138 on 1,395 shares and oil firm Shell was 40 cents higher to 15.20 rupees on 18,842 shares. Happy World Foods edged up by 10 cents to 15.10 rupees on 6,000 shares and conglomerate Rogers was stable at 99 on 287 shares.
In the investment sector, Policy was down by 15 cents to 3.90 rupees on 84,283 shares and Mauritius Development Investment Trust was unchanged at 7.60 rupees on 70,130 shares.
Sugar-based Mon Tresor Mon Desert was unchanged at 38 rupees on a heavy 22,869 shares.
